verdict.rationale: Linear offers a personal My Issues → Assigned view, and its GitHub integration syncs issues so GitHub-synced issues live inside Linear. That implies GitHub-tracked work could appear alongside native tasks, but the evidence never says synced issues show up in My Issues. Jira and other services are only supported through one-way import/migration, not an ongoing aggregated view of tasks still managed in those tools. Missing for 10: live sync of assigned tasks from other PM tools such as Jira or Asana, an explicit cross-tool assigned-work view, documentation that synced external issues appear in My Issues, and hands-on corroboration.
